title: Galbot Robots complete 100 consecutive rallies against a tennis champion
summary: Galbot says its robot completed more than 100 consecutive autonomous tennis rallies against former world number 15 Zheng Jie at the World Humanoid Robot Games in Beijing. A robot spent Saturday rallying with a former Wimbledon semi-finalist.
